target.title: Email item owners when stock runs low
target.description:
After an order, if an item's remaining quantity drops below the threshold,
email the item's owner so they can restock.

summary: This pull request adds functionality to email an item's owner when its stock drops below a threshold after an order is placed.

suspects.title: Missing transaction or concurrency control around stock decrement and notification
suspects.problem: Multiple concurrent orders could cause the stock to drop below the threshold multiple times, potentially spamming the owner with duplicate low stock emails, or database queries might read uncommitted/stale values if orders are not wrapped in a transaction.
suspects.how_to_check: Check app/db.py or order creation logic to see if database operations run inside a transaction block and whether concurrency is handled.

suspects.how_to_check: Examine app/users.py to see what get_user returns when the user ID is not found or if user objects can have a missing email.
